resolutions.researcher_notes: current_ref is a web.archive.org /save/ trigger URL (not a real snapshot viewer link) for https://dnr.gxzf.gov.cn/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/ygzd/jsydpfwj/t18327386.shtml -- confirmed dead/unusable as cited. Found the actual proper snapshot (http://web.archive.org/web/20250528135216/https://dnr.gxzf.gov.cn/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/ygzd/jsydpfwj/t18327386.shtml, a 2024-04-18 Guangxi land-use approval for the Lipu section) but per this repo's own prior deep-sweep audit (batches/china-guangxi-gas/staging/deepsweep-pilot/rows/P4727.json, status_reviews[0]) that document -- plus a Liuzhou municipal investment-plan article (tzcjj.liuzhou.gov.cn, 2023-04-07) listing this project among 2023 '续建' (continuing-construction) projects, and a SECOND 2024-01-29 land-use approval for the Lingui section -- is evidence AGAINST the recorded Status='proposed': three independent government documents place the project at active/continuing construction by 2023, not proposed. I cannot in good conscience propose a ref that 'supports' proposed when the best available sources argue for construction instead. Not proposing any URL here per the standing rule against citing refs for a different-than-recorded value; this is a disagreement, not a dead-link gap -- routes to Update/status-review (already flagged in rows/P4727.json with proposed_changes Status=construction, ConstructionYear=2023).

Guangxi DRC approval doc (桂发改油气〔2022〕640号, 2022-06-10, issued for '桂东北天然气环网桂林-阳朔-荔浦段天然气管道项目') is throughout titled/described as a 天然气管道 (natural gas pipeline) project -- commodity unambiguous. Verified OK on token '天然气'. Single primary source (also reprinted verbatim by bjx.com.cn -- same wire story, not counted as independent), so tier=medium not high.

Recorded ProposalYear=2022 is supported (the Guangxi DRC approval is dated 2022), but recorded ProposalMonth=10 is NOT: the approval document itself (桂发改油气〔2022〕640号) is dated 成文日期 2022-06-10, 批复/issued 2022-06-15 -- June, not October. This exact disagreement was already flagged by this repo's prior deep-sweep audit (rows/P4727.json validity[0]), recommending ProposalMonth be corrected to 06. I could not find any dated document naming an October 2022 milestone for this project (the underlying municipal request 市发改报〔2022〕196号 is undated in the accessible text). Per standing rule, not proposing a ref that would 'support' a month value (10) that the best evidence contradicts -- this is a value disagreement, not a gap, and routes to Update to correct ProposalMonth to 06 (keeping ProposalYear=2022).
